snippet.title: FLASK - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The dark fantasy deck-building auto-battler has set a full release date of January 14th, 2027 (PC and Mac), alongside a major demo overhaul live on Steam now – new Infusers, competitive leaderboards, and shorter, nastier runs. Get rich, get ruthless, get very good at killing goblins.

Wishlist & play the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714280/FLASK/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=flask_pre_big_break&utm_content=description

Developed by Chop Chop Games
Published by Ghost Ship Publishing

Follow FLASK
Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/skPKmFJDnw
